mentions.name: Gelly
mentions.description: A native music client for the Jellyfin media server on Linux, written in Rust and GTK. It emphasizes being fast and avoiding Electron or other cross-platform toolkits, and remains under active development roughly six months in with new features still being added.
mentions.problem: Existing music clients are often slow or rely on Electron and other cross-platform toolkits; users want a fast native alternative.

mentions.name: Gelly
mentions.description: A native Jellyfin client written in Rust, focused specifically on music playback. It provides a desktop alternative to existing Electron- and web-based Jellyfin music clients and is available on Flathub.
mentions.problem: Most existing Jellyfin music clients are Electron- or web-based, with no native option.
mentions.source_excerpt: A Jellyfin client written in Rust, specifically for music. Most existing clients are electron or web based and I wanted something native.

mentions.name: Gelly
mentions.description: A native Jellyfin client focused on music, built with Rust and GTK. Gelly lets users browse and play their Jellyfin-hosted music collection (e.g., from ripped CDs and old hard drives) in a desktop application dedicated to music rather than video.
mentions.problem: Jellyfin is great but lacked a native application focused on music rather than video.
